description: Send one authenticated REST request to any relative path on the registered zuora_tenant. Supply method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE or another vendor method), path, optional query object, non-Authorization headers and JSON body. Vendor RBAC is the only operation boundary. Dispatch returns job_id/status queued; vendor status, selected headers, redacted body and pagination arrive on completion. No redirect, pagination link or HTTP failure is automatically followed or retried.
embedding_description: Authenticated Zuora REST access for reads, writes, deletes, lifecycle actions, tenant settings and custom objects. Supply a relative path; OAuth comes from the registered tenant. GET /workflows lists definitions and GET /workflows/{workflow_id}/export downloads a JSON backup. Vendor RBAC controls available operations.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries status (HTTP integer), headers (selected content, pagination, rate-limit, ETag and request identifiers), body, body_encoding (json/text/base64), pagination, correlation_id and error (typed HTTP error code or null). HTTP errors complete the transport job with their status/body as data. Tokens and secret fields are redacted. Binary downloads are returned losslessly as base64 except any credential bytes, which are redacted.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: The call may have changed vendor state. Queued is not confirmation of a completed write. On completion report HTTP status and body faithfully, including vendor failures and Retry-After; a completed job alone does not mean the operation succeeded. Do not automatically replay writes or deletes. Preserve pagination hints and binary body_encoding; never expose a secret. This generic verb delegates lifecycle, authorization, stale-write and terminal-state rules to Zuora.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One authenticated request to the registered Zuora tenant.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params protects the registered tenant and credentials (relative paths, no caller Authorization, no host change, no CR/LF headers) or identifies malformed typed input. Configuration/OAuth/transport errors use existing Zuora codes. Vendor HTTP 4xx/5xx errors are response data with status, redacted body and typed error; rate limits also preserve Retry-After.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct invalid input or registered tenant credentials. Inspect status/body and vendor RBAC. A response may reflect a changed vendor state; use a vendor read to establish current state before deciding on a retry. Pagination links are hints: issue a new relative-path call when needed.
